fieldData.description:
Radix mainnet gave birth to an amazing ecosystem since it was launched a year ago. Now it is time to celebrate the success we have had in the last year.
So join us in celebrating Radix Olympia Mainnet Launch Anniversary with a ping pong party at Bounce Old Street on Thursday, 28th July at 8:30 pm.
fieldData.name: Radix Community Meetup - London
